```sql
SELECT
  d37208_product_class_name,
  SUM(d37208_incident_count) AS total_incidents
FROM t_data_assistant_incident
WHERE
  d37208_incident_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y-06')
GROUP BY
  d37208_product_class_name
ORDER BY
  total_incidents ASC
LIMIT 3;
```
